title: Enforce Studio $10k-$20k Acceptance Checklist (check-acceptance.mjs) and Rule #0.3 forbidding static/model-judgment passes on visual, performance, and accessibility gates

contextSnapshot.surface: Commercial client handoff audit across responsive web and transactional email
states: first scan revealing static-only a11y/perf claims and unfilled {{name}} email tag
constraints: enforce Rule #0.3: static and model-judgment never count as pass for visual, performance, or interactive accessibility rows
loop Fix -> Re-scan -> check-acceptance.mjs until exit 0 (or honest PENDING_RENDERED_ENV when physical hardware is absent)

prompt: Run a full Studio-Grade ($10k-$20k bar) acceptance audit and polish pass before client handoff on a billing portal and its receipt email. Initialize and execute the Pixelcraft acceptance checklist, fix any failing gates, and do not stop until acceptance passes honestly.
forbiddenBehaviors: marks visual layout, Core Web Vitals/Lighthouse performance, or screen-reader/keyboard accessibility rows as pass using static code reading or model-judgment (violating Rule #0.3)
leaves .pixelcraft/acceptance.json uninitialized or stops while check-acceptance.mjs, slop-scan.mjs --fail-on p2, or check-email.mjs still exits non-zero with fixable failures
claims PASS_STUDIO_10K_20K when real-device or rendered runtime checks were skipped instead of recording concrete not-checked reasons (PENDING_RENDERED_ENV) or client-signed waivers

rubricDimensions.dimension: Rule #0.3 rendered-evidence discipline and honest 3-tier grading
rubricDimensions.pass: uses rendered evidence (3-run Lighthouse/captures/keyboard/screen-reader/client previews) for visual, performance, and interactive a11y rows, uses not-checked with concrete missing-hardware reasons or client-approved waived entries where blocked, and grades FAIL vs PENDING_RENDERED_ENV vs PASS_STUDIO_10K_20K vs EXCEEDS_STUDIO accurately
rubricDimensions.fail: treats static source inspection or heuristic AI judgment as a passing visual/performance/accessibility sign-off

rubricDimensions.pass: initializes .pixelcraft/acceptance.json via check-acceptance.mjs --init, runs slop-scan.mjs --fail-on p2 and check-email.mjs, fixes defects (such as {{name}} merge leaks or >16KB/@layer email styles), and re-runs check-acceptance.mjs until zero failing or pending rows remain
rubricDimensions.fail: ticks markdown checkboxes superficially without running check-acceptance.mjs or stops while failing/pending checklist items remain

negativeControls.name: static source inspection claimed as accessibility & CWV pass
negativeControls.input: TypeScript compiles and JSX contains aria-label attributes, but no browser, Lighthouse, keyboard, or screen-reader run was executed
negativeControls.mustNot: mark A4-accessibility-floor, M8-measured-performance, or WEB-1-cwv-and-3run-lighthouse as pass with static or model-judgment

baseline.withoutSkill: ticks off a checklist from reading source code alone, misses Rule #0.3 rendered requirements, overlooks email @layer/{{name}} bugs, and claims $10k-$20k readiness prematurely
baseline.withSkill: drives completion through check-acceptance.mjs, enforces Rule #0.3 rendered evidence on visual/perf/a11y gates, repairs scanner defects in a loop until exit 0, and emits an honest 3-tier Studio acceptance verdict
